hypothesis: Per-request Gateway TCP/DNS churn exhausts target connection tracking; observed Linux table-full drops and baseline ENA connection allowance drops accompany DNS-path lookup stalls. Reuse should lower churn while retaining the same entrypoint, business responses and workload.

candidate_after.agent: existing opt-in ProxyAgents, per origin, maxSockets128, maxTotalSockets128, maxFreeSockets16, LIFO, retire after30s on return to idle; no retry/timeout/body changes

decision: EXPERIMENT STARTED: only GATEWAY_PROXY_KEEP_ALIVE false -> true; diagnostics remain enabled for lower regression. Retention requires two valid diagnostics-off500 observations, including300s hold.

timing_attribution.limits: DNS observed assignment-to-lookup callback includes resolver/threadpool/callback delay, not isolated DNS-server execution. No cross-service request-ID pairing; dominant-segment counters use the same Gateway upstream request.
